info.title: MLE Home Backend API
info.description: OpenAPI import file for Apidog. This describes the Dockerized local API for student linking, diary records, evidence uploads, OCR inference, privacy decisions, tutor summaries, reports, curriculum standards, and integration metadata.

post.summary: Logout one session by revoking a refresh token
Logout all sessions for the authenticated account

get.summary: List student links for current account
List diary entries for a student
Get diary statistics for a student

post.summary: Infer activity metadata from OCR text or an image object key

patch.summary: Save privacy and sharing decisions for evidence

parameters.name: includeImages
parameters.description: Only includes image object keys when evidence has been approved for image inclusion.

200.description: Tutor statistics report for the student.

OcrInferRequest.description: At least one of text or imageObjectKey is required.
